messages:
jamal: Heads-up — Acme (tenant acme-341) reports Console hourly usage is ~4-6 hours behind. They see empty bars for hours 02:00-06:00 UTC. Ticket #12345 opened. Can data/infra triage?

support-bot: Ticket #12345 created and linked to this thread. Priority: P2.

lina: Looking at consumer metrics — analytics-ingest consumer group lag spiked at ~02:15 UTC and has ~2.7M lagged messages for partition 3. Grafana panel: /d/ingest/consumer-lag (private).

alex: I noticed a schema change rolled at 01:55 UTC to the rollups writer service (PR #4123). Logs show write errors around 02:05: 
```
ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "hourly_rollups_pkey"
context: writing rollup for tenant acme-341 hour 2026-03-17T02:00:00Z
```
This may be causing backpressure.

maria: There's also a backfill job BR-789 that started at 03:00 UTC targeting multiple tenants. It looks like BR-789 is doing full re-ingest without dedupe and hammering the writers. Quick check: 
```
SELECT id, state, started_at FROM backfills WHERE id='BR-789';
-- id | state  | started_at
-- BR-789 | running | 2026-03-17 03:00:12+00
```

lina: Oncall action plan: 1) pause BR-789, 2) scale rollup-writers from 2 -> 4, 3) drain consumer backlog, 4) run targeted re-ingest for acme for 02:00-06:00 with dedupe. Who can stop BR-789?

alex: I can stop it now: `curl -X POST https://internal.jobs/api/v1/stop/BR-789 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"` — doing that.

deploy-bot: job BR-789 stopped by alex at 1823451200.

maria: After stopping BR-789, monitoring: consumer lag dropped from ~2.7M -> ~12k within 15m. Rollup writer error rate fell back to baseline.

jamal: I informed Acme support contact with an initial ETA of ~2 hours for visible updates. They requested interim CSV with hourly counts for affected hours.

maria: SQL to get hourly counts for manual CSV: 
```
SELECT hour, coalesce(sum(token_count),0) as tokens
FROM hourly_rollups
WHERE tenant_id='acme-341' AND hour BETWEEN '2026-03-17 02:00:00+00' AND '2026-03-17 08:00:00+00'
GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
```
I'll export and share once we confirm stabilization.

lina: I'm scaling rollup-writers now and will kick off a controlled re-ingest for acme with concurrency=2 and dedupe=true. Will post job id when scheduled.

alex: Re-ingest job RG-210 scheduled for acme window 02:00-06:00 with dedupe. Starting in 5m.

maria: First two hours (03:00-04:00) are already backfilled and show in Console. Hour 02:00 still missing, looks like an older partition issue on s3 that RG-210 can't see. Investigating archive partition id p-20260317-02.

jamal: Please confirm when all hours visible, and I'll update Acme. Also add incident note for postmortem (root cause: concurrent backfill + schema change causing writer contention).

lina: Will follow up with a short incident blameless note and remediation: ensure backfills run with dedupe by default + safety throttle.

alex: Update: partition p-20260317-02 had a filename prefix mismatch after the 01:55 deploy; I fixed the mapper and kicked a metadata refresh. RG-210 re-run should pick it up now.

maria: Verified counts for 02:00 populated after metadata refresh. Dashboard now shows contiguous bars 02:00-06:00. Exported CSV and uploaded to ticket (#12345).

jamal: Great — closing loop with Acme and marking ticket as 'awaiting customer confirmation'. Thanks all.
